balls.text: it's a low full toss outside off and Jadeja bunts it down to long-off for a couple that takes CSK to 140
this time he loses his line. Full and way too wide outside off
yorker just outside off, Jaddu digs it out to long-off and picks up a couple
slower ball fools Ashwin again. Decides on a sweep soon enough for Southee to see his intentions and the inside edge onto pad only fetches a single
fired into the blockhole outside off, Jaddu swipes it down to long-on
slower delivery outside off, Jaddu was shuffling towards it and then leaves it alone thinking it was wide. Very optimistic from him, terrific bowling from Southee
full and sliding across him, Jaddu slices it and gets a thick outside edge to Watson at point. He lobs in a throw but the bowler fails to collect and gives an extra run
gets the wide yorker bang on and Jaddu manages to retain strike with a single through point
full and wide and Jaddu gets under it and carves it through extra cover. Long-off is quick enough to keep it to a couple
fullish and outside off, Ashwin hoists it over the top. The connection is poor though and it doesn't reach the two men in the deep.

bowls it full and outside off, Ashwin has premeditated and walks across and looks to sweep fine. Too full for that. Jaddu races across for the single and would have been out had Southee hit the stumps at the bowlers'
outside edge and off it flies to the third man boundary. Full and sliding across the right-hander, Ashwin shuffles across and swings. Gets lucky
full and just outside off, Jaddu belts it down to long-off
low full toss which had ample room to slash square on the off side. Jaddu connects well but he can't thread the gap between point and backward point
walks across and pulls this slower short ball to deep midwicket
fullish and outside off, Ashwin looks to launch over cover but can't connect. He's two off eight now
sets up for the lap sweep but it's a slower ball and Ashwin doesn't adjust to the pace. Southee was way wide on the bowler crease. He was almost cutting the line there
goes wide of the crease and gets a fuller delivery to straighten outside off. Ashwin has a waft and misses
seeks the yorker but ends up a low full toss that's bunted off the bottom of the bat to long-on
this time he's on target. Finds the block hole just a shade outside off and Ashwin who was looking to jam it down to third man, misses
more exercise for the umpire as Kulkarni bowls the 10th wide of the innings. Ashwin had moved across and looked to dab it to third man but can't get it
another one. Does he really need to be afraid of being belted by a batsman who's only four balls into his innings? And it's not like Ash is known for his big hits
terrible line there. His search for the wide yorker goes wildly awry
low full toss outside off, Jaddu slashes to deep point
short ball and he pounces on it. Let one go earlier in the over but this time he puts a lot more muscle into the shot. And found the gap between long-on and midwicket
this time he strays on the wrong side of the tram lines. Jaddu judges the line of this wide yorker well and shoulders arms
fires in a wide yorker that is just inside the wide line. Jaddu's leave doesn't end up being profitable
shortish and a touch outside off, he stays back and pulls in front of deep square leg
slants a slower ball across him and Jaddu swings and misses
full and wide outside off, Jaddu squeezes it to deep cover
skips down the track again and Watson fires it in at the pads. Clipped away through square leg
walks at him and he's spotted the movement early and fires it wide outside off, Ashwin wonders about the extra but it's not given
legcutter which Ashwin tries to steer past the keeper. Doesn't go wide enough and seeing Ash just about out of his crease Samson has a shy at the stumps. Jaddu steals the single off the ricochet
starts with a full toss on the pads. Offcutter gone wrong actually and Jaddu clips it to deep square leg
full and outside off, he strides forward to block

who needs pace when he can keep snapping batsmen up like that. Another leg cutter and I bet it was still well under 100ks. Manhas was looking to cut it into the gap behind point but the ball gained just a little more bounce and he steered it straight into the hands of the square fielder
another leg cutter but it's a tad short and he pulls to deep midwicket
fuller legcutter this time and Jaddu is forward with a block
fullish and just outside off, Manhas opens the face and picks up a single behind point
offcutter which is worked away into the leg side. The two batsmen hesitated in the middle of the pitch and there was ample opportunity for the run out but Bhatia does not field it cleanly
tossed up outside off, Manhas pushes it into the covers. That ends his spell, a very decent one indeed
flighted on off stump, but he still stays back to slice it to point
a bit of flight to the right-hander but his line goes wrong. Manhas was looking to glance it fine but it's a better result for the team as the ball scurries away for five wides
pushes him back again with a quicker skidding leg break. With pace on the ball, Jaddu has little trouble turning it through midwicket
flat on middle, Jaddu waits on his back foot and clips it between midwicket and square leg. Easy two there
flighted outside off and he taps it through the covers
there's some aggression. Lashes it inside out over the cover field. Made room and opened up his stance to place it in the gap
back of a length and outside off, steered down to deep third man. That brings the strategic time out as well
offcutter now, pushed full on leg stump. Jadeja turns it away square into the leg side
stays deep in his crease and works the back of a length ball through to deep midwicket
full on the pads, Jaddu flicks it behind square leg
back of a length and just outside off, Jaddu looks to force it through the off side but he can't beat cover
no pace offered as this is fullish and outside off, Jadeja steers it to point
tossed up on middle and leg, the clip can't beat midwicket

stays back and lets the ball turn and then guides it behind point with an open face. Couple of runs craftily done. Quite a delay from the third umpire considering Manhas has dragged his bat into his crease before the stumps were broken by the keeper
flatter delivery on off stump, he goes back and pushes down to long-on
flighted on middle and leg, Jaddu wanted to block but had to bring it around his front pad, Mild appeal but it would have gone down leg
flighted on leg stump, Jaddu glances it to the left of short fine leg and it has enough to skim off to the boundary. Tambe's angry with his poor line

he's picked out deep square leg! Faulkner hardly had to move! Dhoni looked quite dangerous skipping down the track and he connected pretty cleanly as well. But he forgot all about the placement. A terribly soft dismissal considering the situation
another offcutter on middle, Jaddu turns it to short midwicket
stays back and nurdles the good length ball behind square leg. He was charging down the pitch, looking for a second but it's not there
fullish and outside off, he comes forward to block and gets a thick edge through to third man. The offcutter grips and bounces off this slow deck
length ball outside off, Jaddu pushes down to the right of mid-off
fullish on middle, Dhoni pushes down the ground and mid-off cuts across to keep it to a single

This would have been a catch, but now it might well be a run-out. It was another legcutter and Dhoni was looking to force it down the ground. But the punch had no power in it. Bhatia dives to his right and gets the very tip of his fingers on it and luckily for Royals it strikes the stumps
this time he spots Faf coming down the pitch and pulls the length back. A bit of turn as well for the batsman to negotiate. All he can do is block
nonchalantly nudged down the ground to long-on. Tambe giving the ball some nice air
leans forward and woks the tossed up delivery into midwicket
doesn't put him off the shot though and this time he employs better technique. Goes across and scoops the tossed up delivery from leg stump for pick up  a couple
hit around the neck! That's the other side of a scoop shot. He's run it onto his own body to in trying to find the boundary fine behind the keeper
flighted on off stump, Dhoni almost flicks it down to long-off
another leg cutter, Dhoni taps it in front of point and these two are quite quick between the wickets
fullish on off stump, Dhoni leans forward to block
leg cutter bowled fullish on off stump, Faf punches down to mid-on. Less than 95ks that
good length and just outside off, not too much pace on it. Faf gets behind it and pushes to short extra cover

and finally the slower ball has him! It's not a short one though. Raina backed away to flay the good length offcutter through the off side and gets a thick outside edge that lobs to short third man. Kulkarni dives forward and plucks a pretty neat take
fullish and outside off, Faf opens the face to ease it behind point
shortish and in the channel, Faf taps it down to third man
top edges a short ball! But there is no one at square leg. It was the offcutter as well and Raina must have had his heart in his mouth.
back of a length and just outside off, Faf rides it behind point
even Binny bowls short at Raina. Got good height on it too, but it is well negotiated as he went back and pulled down to long leg

that's instant revenge and Smith throws his head back! He's spliced a slower, back of a length ball down the throat of mid-off. He was trying his best to make some room to lash it quite a bit squarer than where it ended up but the ball struck him a little too high on the bat and he wasn't able to instill any power into the shot
slightly short to start with and Smith has mauled it into the stands behind cow corner. Flat, hard, murderous. That's an emphatic way to reach fifty
meets it on the full after using his feet, but he doesn't beat midwicket
flighted outside off, Raina closes the face on impact and pushes it back to the bowler
skips down the track and squeezes it through point. Neat stroke but Southee from the deep sends in a rocket through right on top of the stumps and Raina just about makes it
almost through him! Got the legspinner to dip just before it reached the batsman and the turn almost allowed it to sneak through bat and pad
I think this went on with the arm and Raina opened the face to find point
tossed up on middle, Raina the new batsman pushes down the pitch

this time he goes aerial. That's CSK's fifty and you wouldn't have believed they had lost a wicket in that over. It was fullish on off stump, but he stayed put to make sure his arms had enough room to swing clean through the line. The advertising boards at long-off takes a battering again
low full toss on off stump, Smith plants his front leg down the pitch and drills it to the long-off boundary. There was no stopping that
and he shows he can be delicate as well. Late cuts a back of a length ball from off stump and beats short third man
that time he had no trouble despite the lack of room. It has to be on middle to keep him quiet and this was down leg stump and Smith has pulverized it to the long leg boundary

Smithy, you absolute sensation! Three men were hunting down that catch, it was about to land just out of reach but he dives and sticks out both hand and plucks it out of it's trajectory! It was length but Baz hit it a little too high on the bat. It was a very difficult skier somewhere beyond the circle in the midwicket region but he was quick enough and athletic enough to pull it off
he's looking quite eager. Charges down the pitch and targets the cover field, but has to settle for a thick edge that almost finds the boundary at point. The edges on these cricket bats!
slower ball gone wrong there as he slides it down the leg side
no trouble timing that one. Again when there is width on offer Smith looks imperious. Sinks down to reach the almost wide yorker and squeezes it through point
terrific bowling. They're getting their slower balls on target. Southee presents a leg cutter, something he's been working on lately and deceives the batsman. Smith was again way too soon on the pull

skips down the track and almost yorks himself, drills the ball down to mid-on and runs with the shot. Steve Smith is the man there and strikes the stumps direct. But he had enough momentum to make his ground
pulls his length back and targets middle, Smith is able to whip it away through midwicket this time
smack! Southee goes wide of the crease but makes the fatal error of providing an overpitched delivery outside off. Smith is on the front foot and pummels it flat over the long-off boundary
he's having trouble when he's cramped for room. Slow on the draw against a fuller skidder that darts in at his pads. Flick shot employed, but in vain
back of a length and outside off, Smith stands up tall and punches through the gap at extra
the slower ball bouncer works against the other opener. Smith was done with the shot ages before it came up and hit the back of his helmet. Has an embarrassed grin on his face
and when the change of pace is dug in short, he lunges forward and swats it to deep square leg. He's certainly not holding back if he sees anything in his area
another slower ball keeps McCullum into a a forward defensive
slightly slower on middle stump, Baz steps forward and blocks
seeks the block hole on off stump, Baz digs it out to mid-off
slower ball off the back of the hand, Baz has spotted it as he shuffles across and picks it away off his hips
fuller delivery on and around off stump, eased into the covers again
that was in the slot and Smith has taken ample toll. Length ball on off stump and a free swing of his strong arms sends crashing into the sight screen
fullish and wide outside off, Smith slaps it into the cover field
makes an ugly thwack on impact as Baz meets this fuller delivery with a defensive push. Gets it off the outside half of the bat as Watson swoops down on it from mid-off

leading edge has enough to fly down to third man. Tambe was the fielder there but he can't cut the angle quick enough to get under it. A swifter man down there might have made that into a chance. Back of a length delivery seams away from Smith as he was looking to whip it through square leg

of course he will. Charges down the track for the very first ball he faces today and turns a fuller delivery into a full toss. Only he strikes it at the very bottom of the bat and should consider himself lucky that it didn't carry to Watson at mid-off
full and angled in at him and the angle was more acute with his moving wide of the crease. Smith nudges to square leg

changes it up with the indipper and Smith is a little late in whipping it through midwicket. Inside edges it onto the pads and lingers outside his crease as he searches for the ball. Sees Southee charging at him and backtracks into his crease
sneaks a little wide of the crease to add a little more teeth to a fuller delivery that straightens outside off. Smith was looking to flay it over the off side and is well beaten
short of a good length, Smith still prods forward and blocks to the bowler. Not enough room to enable the power he wanted to use
fullish but dipping on the pads, Smith works it away to deep square leg
pushes down to mid-on off the back foot to keep strike

and there's the first bit of misbehaviour from the pitch. This good length ball holds up a little more and Smith was into his defensive push quite early. Has to pull his bottom hand off and yet it went a little uppishly to point
just back of a length, Smith's weight was on the front foot as he punches to cover point
goes fuller on off stump, Smith steps forward and blocks the outswinger with an open face
bit of seam away and Smith is mindful of it as he leaves it alone
that was clean! Invited Smith on the front foot and was also offering enough room for him to exploit. A simple extension of the arms sends it scurrying through the cover field

low full toss outside off, Kulkarni has thumped it down to long-on.Kulkarni has racing to retain strike,  Tambe has to go for the two but he just camped at the strikers and said no. Kulkarni was the only man who could have got those runs, no matter how much Tambe explains after being out by yards

carrom ball on leg stump and Kulkarni has pummeled this over square leg. Dhoni is in deep conversation with his bowler. That was such a powerful strike. Not to mention a pretty poor ball from Ashwin. Length in the last over
this was tossed up way outside off and Kulkarni has thrown his bat for a couple. That was a wide for the taking
that's what they want. Got under it nicely and though he had to hit against the turn it was in the slot to cart over to the midwicket boundary and that's exactly what he does
premeditated a lap sweep as Ashwin delivers the carrom ball. Gets a single to long leg
makes room outside leg to loft this shortish ball angled into him over the head of point.
shortish and outside off, he dabs it away to deep third man
back of a length on middle and he wasn't too keen to stay in line. Backs away and blocks
shortish again and Bhatia goes for a pull. Only succeeds in getting a top edge that soars into the night sky before settling in the hands of Ashwin in the covers
goes for a wild swipe as he sees some room outside off. It was back of a length and it was too quick for him
back of a length and outside off, he heaves it around to deep square leg
shortish and outside off, Bhatia rocks back and pulls between long-on and deep midwicket
he was coming down the track but Ashwin shortens his length and forces the batsman to punch to midwicket
swings across the line and gets an inside edge to the flighted delivery on middle. Deep square leg tidies up
tossed up and it was the one that spins the other way. Bhatia comes forward and clips it down to long-on
carrom ball on leg stump, picked away to long leg
flighted on off stump, he shuffles back and across and blocks
rank long hop and Bhatia has pulled it with the greatest authority
darted in on off stump, Kulkarni pushes it down to long-on
tossed up on the pads, Bhatia turns it through to deep midwicket
that's smashed out of here! Comes down the track to launch the flatter ball into the sight screen
flighted on off stump, he opens the face and drives through to long-off
flighted and angled in on leg stump, gets a thick outside edge that scurries away down to third man
carrom ball, grips and turns as much as a leg spinner. Batsman hadn't a clue as he reads it off the pitch and dabs into the off side
flighted outside off, swept away behind square leg
skips down the track, but Ashwin is wise to it as he pulls the length back. Can only defend down the pitch
goes for the slog as he sees it tossed up on off stump. Mistimes it to deep square leg
flighted on off stump, defended feebly into the covers
swept away to long leg as this is on a length and on the pads
tossed up outside leg stump, Bhatia goes for the sweep but can't connect
gives this a lot of air and sees the ball turn appreciably outside off. The batsman doesn't want anything to do with it though
flighted on off stump, defended down the pitch
pushed in on middle and leg and Bhatia was playing around his front pad. Could've been a close leg before if he hadn't hit that through square leg
flighted on off stump, eased down the ground for a single by Dhawal Kulkarni the new batsman
off stump is pegged back and Jaddu is on a roll! It was flat, it skidded off the deck and it sneaked below Southee's intended cut
flighted on off stump, he skips down the track and drills it through the covers

dropped and it's Faf there at slip! Southee gently steered the back of a length ball to the fielder's right. He had to dive and Faf usually gobbles those but this bests him. Ahsiwn has a hand around his shoulder in comfort
short ball and Southee's carted it away behind square. Pulled that with considerable disdain
back of a length on off stump, Southee defends off the back foot

he's nicked off! There wasn't much of an appeal from the keeper but Ishwar knew it straight away. Fullish delivery nibbling away outside off, Faulkner chases after it and gets a pretty thick edge. That's the strategic time out as well
sliding down leg and Faulkner has glanced it quite fine. Mohit runs across but mistimes the slide. The ball sneaks in through his legs and into the boundary
fullish on off stump, Bhatia whips it around to long-on
Faf has been put at long-off and it goes straight to him! Jaddu pulled his length back a little but Smith still went after it. But he picked out the fielder. Punches his bat in disgust
fires in the arm ball on middle, Bhatia hurries into a defensive
nicely tossed up on middle and he waits for it to turn before defending with an angled bat
and Smith plays with the field by getting down the track, taking the ball on the full and creaming it through extra cover
he skips down the track and thumps the flighted delivery down the ground. Mohit is at long-off, rushes to his right and dives. Gets both hands to it but it pops out. Dhoni asks him to move straighter
tossed up on off stump, Bhatia drills it through the covers
shortish and curling away, Smith was stuck in his crease as he looked to smack it through the off side. Bottom-edges it to the covers
fullish on off stump, Bhatia nudges into the off side and sets off. Manhas is the man there and he sends in a throw that clatters the stumps at the bowler' but Bhatia was home
back of a length and outside off, Bhatia looks to dab it down to third man and misses
rips a back of a length delivery away from him. Bhatia had no chance with that.
bit of movement away from the bat and squared him up. Smith someone manages to keep it down and pick up a single to deep third man
probes the channel outside off and is steered down to deep third man
back of a length on off stump, pushed to midwicket

right down Faf's throat at long-off. Binny chooses a very bad shot there as he looks to smite it down the ground. Gets it off the bottom of the bat, which turns in his hands, and Faf controls a simple catch
length ball outside off, Binny heaves over the top. It's a mis-hit and long-off is too far away
shortish and outside off, but it came a little slower off the deck. Binny was swinging off his feet and gets a thick bottom edge to deep third man
back of a length and outside off, punched through to the sweeper
back of a length and outside off, Smith drags it away to deep midwicket with a pull. Didn't get it off the middle though
tossed up on leg stump, defended
keeps it on the pads and Smith tucks it away off square on the leg side
fired in on a good length on the pads, turned away through square leg

Dhoni has fluffed a stumping! You don't see that too often. He juggled it about three times with Smith still halfway down the pitch. But he just could not get it in the gloves. The ball turned through his flick, Raina beat him in the flight, and would have had him stranded
holds it back and Binny works it away through the leg side
flighted on middle, Smith clips it away to deep square leg
full on off stump, he pushes it down to long-off to keep strike. Which he will take after the time out
slower ball outside off and Smith saw fine leg inside the circle and pulls it past his despairing dive. That's a wonderfully collected couple
this stays low and it squirts in at him as well. Smith manages to present a straight bat to stop it crashing into his stumps
short ball outside off, Smith has to reach for it and gets it off the bottom of the bat and can't beat the sweeper
Back of a length and outside off, he goes back and punches it to the sweeper
shortish and outside off, Binny stays back and cuts to the sweeper
he doesn't want to flight the ball at all. Binny gets down the track and punches to mid-on
advances down the pitch and clips the shortish ball through square leg
shortish and outside off, he goes deep in his crease and cuts through the covers
short deliver on off stump, Binny can only push it back to the bowler
flighted on off stump, Binny is forward and clips his first ball to midwicket
skips down the track and yorks himself as Jaddu darts in a fuller delivery on leg stump. Digs it out

that's two in two! Jadeja gets reward for floating it up in the air. Samson is forward and looks to clip through midwicket, closes the face too early and gets a leading edge that is pouched by the bowler himself. Punches the air and screams in triumph

slowed it up this time and the extra flight dupes him. Watson doesn't hold back as he goes over the top again. This time it's the leading edge that gains more height than distance. Hilfy was at long-off and leaps up to hold down a pretty good catch. Think he was very worried about the rope, but it was well behind him
skips down the track and reaches the pitch and once that's done he smacks it straight down the ground. Clears long-on easily
pushed through on the pads, Watson has to bring his bat around his front pad and gets struck on it

and produces a ripper straight away. Darts it in on off stump but when it hits the pitch it gains a ton of turn and beats the outside edge handsomely. Dhoni is quick to whip the bails off but Watson has grounded his back leg
walks way down leg to try and fool the bowler but Ashwin isn't lulled into it. Bowls flat on middle and leg and restricts it to a tap to point
flatter delivery on off stump, Samson stays back and blocks
tossed up on leg stump and Watson nudges it through midwicket
good length ball on off stump, Watson is far forward and blocks
goes for the slog sweep and he's picked out the man in the deep! He had to drag a good length ball that went on with the arm, which hampers his timing and Manhas at deep square leg holds on easily
flatter on leg stump, Rahane clips it square leg

length again and Samson has sent it into orbit! That was like his captain - planting his front leg down the ground and slapping it through the line and into the stands behind long-on. Royals are on their way
picked away off his knees as he goes for the length ball on middle. Single to square leg
back of a length and outside off, Samson guides it to deep third man
looks for the change of pace and Samson picked it up early, backed away and pounded it over long-on. He may be a small lad but he hits it long
back of a length and tucks him up on leg, Samson pushes to mid-on
strides forward and hits the fullish delivery on the up to point. Hilfy still getting it to nibble away
back of a length outside off, Samson dabs it to the right of short third man for a single
misfield at point gets him off the mark. Tempts him with a fuller delivery outside off and Samson is forward with a drive. Jaddu has to dive to his right but doesn't make it
he needs to settle down here. Samson looks to hit on the up ever ball and the little bit of away moment is making him look all the more ugly. Excellent lengths from the seamer
fullish and outside off, Samson looks to slap it over the off side and is beaten. Dhoni does well, being up to the stumps

this one strays a little too close on middle and Rahane clips it off his hips to deep square leg. It's a tough chase down there but Hilfy's game enough to slide and keep it to three. Royals have got a little momentum here
gorgeous stroke! There were two men square on the off side but Rahane has threaded it through them. Went back and across and timed the punch brilliantly
gets a thick inside edge to a shortish delivery that darts away off the deck. Into the back-foot punch a little too early
shortish and outside off, clipped away in front of square leg
back of a length and on off stump, Rahane was looking to bring those wrists into play again but he is surprised by the bounce this gets. Mis-hits to mid-on
looks to steer this down to third man, dangerous tactic with those two slips. Only just avoids nicking behind. Lovely outswing from Hilfy
fullish and outside off but Rahane is forward and rolls his wrists on top of the ball and drags it through midwicket
invites the batsman forward with an away swinger as Rahane nudges into the covers
beaten this time as Pandey tempts him outside off with a short of a good length delivery.
shortish and a shade outside off, Samson cuts to point
hint of seam away but it's nothing to trouble him as he rides it to point off the back foot

fullish and curling in again as Nayar swings across the line. There's a big leg before appeal and the batsman has absently wandered down the pitch. McCullum swoops down on the ball from short cover and races over to the keeper's end and flicks the bails off. Terrific presence of mind from the NZ captain
charges down the track but Pandey shortens the length and foils his hopes for acceleration
cuts him in half with a good length delivery that nips back in quite late. Nayar was on the front foot looking to force it through midwicket but can't hit it
beauty to end the over, unplayable from Hilfenhaus, pitching around off and jagging away, Rahane does well to not nick it
gets the ball to curl away outside off, a thick outside edge as Rahane pokes at it, past the slip for four, too fine for third man
short of length ball on off stump, pushed towards cover for a single
length ball is whipped away towards the square leg innings, again the line is on the legs, Nayar capitalises
gets the ball to swerve but starts on the wrong side, down the leg side
pitched up, 136kph, defended towards cover off the front foot
starts with a back of length ball that cramps up Abhishek Nayar as he looks to work it to the leg side, struck on the thigh pad
